scope: Production Candidate v1 design consistency only; no unseen cohort matrix exists yet.

checks.name: stage ownership is ordered and non-overlapping
checks.evidence: The Candidate path declares one ordered owner for situation, evidence, selection, validation, calibration, writing, final validation, and repetition audit.

checks.name: v4 language architecture is frozen rather than modified
checks.evidence: README fixes v4 as the language layer and manifest pins its freeze and contract artifacts.

checks.name: selector remains evidence-grounded selection only
checks.evidence: Selector may select cited behavior/applicability or BLOCKED; it cannot write a Lens or force cross-identity difference.

checks.name: BLOCKED cannot become generic fallback copy
checks.evidence: Both direct-applicability and failure sections terminate BLOCKED before writing.

checks.name: person-first and human-language gates occur before writing
checks.evidence: The gates are non-generative validation/calibration steps before the v4 writer.

checks.name: meaning and actor preservation occur after writing
checks.evidence: Final validation follows the writer and includes actor preservation.

checks.name: repetition policy allows honest similarity and blocks lazy duplication
checks.evidence: The design forbids semantic-distance, unique-action, unique-topic, and unique-rhythm requirements.

checks.name: repetition checks cannot force unsupported rewrites
checks.evidence: Repetition controls block or hold; they do not manufacture a new behavior or action.

checks.name: validation path has no production or shadow write path
checks.evidence: Manifest and plan both declare development-only, zero provider calls, and empty write paths.

checks.name: unseen-cohort plan requires broad unseen coverage and neutral situations
checks.evidence: The plan proposes 24 cases with 12 identities, broad scenario coverage, and explicit non-overlap requirements.

checks.name: unseen-cohort plan separates automated checks from human product judgment
checks.evidence: Human review remains required after compliance validation.

checks.name: frozen input hash: v4 language architecture freeze
frozen input hash: v4 writer contract
frozen input hash: human-language calibration complete
frozen input hash: neutral insight selector contract
frozen input hash: selector evidence boundary
frozen input hash: selector paid-run evidence

cohortReadiness.statement: The design passes. Cohort-specific non-overlap, case IDs, source fingerprints, and scenario-leakage assertions are required at the later matrix-freeze preflight.
